question:
In a Young’s double-slit experiment, the two slits are illuminated by the same monochromatic source. Just before the slits, ideal polarizers $P_1$ and $P_2$ are placed in front of slit $S_1$ and slit $S_2$, respectively.

The incident light on each polarizer is unpolarized and has the same intensity. The transmission axes of $P_1$ and $P_2$ make an angle $\theta$ with each other.

Assume both slits have identical widths and the diffraction envelope is the same for both beams. Determine the fringe visibility $V$ (contrast) of the interference pattern on the screen as a function of $\theta$.
